dataset: Mozilla Common Voice (hi, ta, te, mr, bn) + ASVspoof 2019 LA bonafide subset
disparityNotes: Largest gap: Dravidian FPR is ~1.7× Indo-Aryan at the same TPR operating point; PSTN narrowband is ~2.3× wideband. These are real evaluation gaps, not smoothed.
mitigations: Dual-profile fusion weights already down-weight pure acoustics on PSTN (Context §10.4).
Corroboration gate prevents acoustic-only L3+ escalation (false-positive stress scenario).
P12 roadmap: retrain with Common Voice Tamil/Telugu oversampling and report FPR parity delta.
